derived_results.claim: Re-expressed the frozen NIG predictive q and Gaussian directional ratio entirely in block mean ybar and centered SSE W. q(y,W)=K W^(29/2)[2+W/2+ybar^2/(2a)]^-19 with a=35/96; the Gaussian W^(29/2) factor cancels exactly from p_theta/p_rho.

Derived closed-form conservative cell extrema for q, p_theta, each symmetric corner component, and H_t. q is unimodal in W and monotone in ybar^2; log p_theta is optimized in sigma at clipped sqrt(A/32); symmetric corner density decreases in |ybar| because 32 h^2/s^2<1; H_t is a convex quadratic in z.

A 16x16 parameter partition and 260x260 compact sufficient-statistic partition, with deliberately inflated 1e-8 endpoint/factor guards, gives global lower sum C_tt>=7.210174 at rho=0.55441744. Refinement lower sums increase from 4.2355 at 180x180 to 8.5005 at 320x320. The worst parameter cell is mu in [0,0.0066143], sigma in [1.065185,1.074514], consistent with the engineering minimum near mu=0,sigma=u.

The former broad C_tt proof blocker is narrowed to machine certification of exp/log/cosh rounding and final-rho transport. Predictive tails and parameter-continuum coverage are handled by monotone compact box bounds with >7 nat slack at the chosen resolution.

negative_or_scope_evidence: Do not call C_tt formally machine-certified yet: standard binary64 transcendental functions were guarded but not executed under a directed-rounding interval library.
The enclosure used rho=0.55441744 rather than a certified rho interval.
A first compact C_mumu box attempt exposed severe dependency blow-up when numerator and denominator W decay were bounded independently; no mean-curvature conclusion is taken from that failed route.
All results remain confined to the standardized frozen m=32 NIG predictor and iid Gaussian null rectangle.

candidate_new.mechanism: Use exact monotonic/unimodal sufficient-statistic cell extrema instead of generic quadrature to lower-enclose the log-scale RIPr curvature over the full Gaussian null rectangle. The large positive lower margin allows the remaining machine-rounding proof to focus only on outward transcendental evaluation, with no tail theorem or dense parameter transport needed.
candidate_new.status: mathematical box-enclosure route closed; directed-rounding backend and rho-interval transport pending
